headline: APR Q3 Revenue Hits Record Despite Currency Pressures on Margins
summary: APR reported record third-quarter 2026 revenue, though foreign exchange headwinds exerted compression on its quarterly operating profit margins.
why: Quarterly earnings results from specialized industrial and corporate equipment operators reflect underlying demand dynamics and FX transaction exposure.

impacts.why: Achieved record quarterly revenues offset by foreign exchange-driven margin compression.
